answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen pricing despite the mandated 18% spend reduction, while the contract ends in 14 days. The prior low-cost-vendor experience is the most relevant evidence that a primary switch can materially reduce unit cost and be onboarded quickly. However, with the line at 94% committed volume, the prior record does not by itself establish that the new vendor can sustain delivery at current required volume; this delivery and transition risk must be verified before commitment. Renewal remains the lower-interruption fallback but appears incompatible with the required cost outcome.
